name: Multnomah County Democrats (MultDems)
lean_basis: Official county Democratic Party organization. Its 2026 Election Hub profiles Democratic nominees in partisan races and every registered Democrat in nonpartisan races without choosing among them. Its Central Committee voted to support Measure 26-267.

name: Multnomah County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county Republican Party organization. Its Nov. 2026 guide (posted Oct. 13) asks voters to back Republican nominees, names two Portland District 3 council candidates, and opposes two local tax measures.

name: Northwest Oregon Labor Council, AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO labor council (Willamette Week: more than 100 unions). Labor federations back Democrats almost exclusively; in Portland's nonpartisan 2026 races it backs the council's moderate Democrats over its democratic-socialist members, and it opposes Measure 26-267. Its own endorsement page requires a login, so candidate picks here come from candidates' signed Voters' Pamphlet endorsement listings.

name: Portland Metro Chamber (formerly Portland Business Alliance)
lean_basis: Regional chamber of commerce, renamed from the Portland Business Alliance in 2023; its political arm is United for Portland. Labeled lean_right like business associations elsewhere in this guide, for its lower-tax, pro-business agenda. Note: every candidate it backs in 2026 is a Democrat or a nonpartisan moderate; it says it wants 'independent progressives' to break the council's 6-6 split.

name: Basic Rights Oregon PAC
lean_basis: Political arm of Oregon's statewide LGBTQ+ rights group; its PAC board endorses 'champions for LGBTQ+ equality.' Its 2026 list is all Democrats or progressive nonpartisan candidates. It considers only candidates who ask, and does not endorse in federal races.

name: City Club of Portland
lean_basis: Self-described 'nonpartisan, member-led' civic group founded in 1916. It takes positions through member-voted research reports and ballot measure studies, so it is an endorser, not a neutral explainer. No independent bias rating found; neutral is its self-description, not a rating.
